StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. As a Account Executive, you will play an important role in driving new business growth by identifying and engaging potential customers across agencies and brands. Reporting to the Sales Director, you will focus on building a strong pipeline through proactive prospecting while also managing opportunities through to close.

This role is well suited to someone with 2+ of sales or business development experience who is looking to take the next step in their career and develop into a high-performing digital advertising seller.

You will spend a large portion of your time identifying new opportunities, reaching out to prospective clients, and introducing StackAdapt’s programmatic advertising solutions. You’ll work closely with the Sales and Account Management teams to support the full sales cycle — from initial outreach through to campaign launch and ongoing client success.

StackAdapt is a remote-first company for this role we will be hiring candidates based in England.

  • Drive new business growth by proactively identifying and engaging agency and brand partners through strategic outbound outreach
  • Build and own a high-quality sales pipeline, developing strong relationships with prospective clients and creating long-term revenue opportunities

  • 2+ years of experience in sales, business development in media or advertising

  • A disciplined and organised approach to pipeline building and opportunity tracking
  • Familiarity with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar
  • Interest in digital advertising and programmatic media
  • Strong communication and presentation skills

description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. Our perspective on GTM. We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls. The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits. Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here. Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere. Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening. The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human. We don't think the talent market has caught up with this shift yet, which is why most of our GTM team came from outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common. We expect these roles to become far more desirable for the right people. High leverage, high reward, intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that. The role. Clinicians outside the NHS - in private healthcare, veterinary, CICs and more - are finding Heidi, using it and telling their colleagues. Your job is to turn that individual enthusiasm into a decision for the whole clinic: understand what’s working, who else needs to be involved and what it will take to get the team onboard. You’ll own the full sales cycle across small and medium-sized private healthcare businesses in the UK. You might speak to an independent specialist who runs their own practice, a clinic manager bringing several clinicians together or an owner making decisions across multiple sites. You’ll need to understand the clinical workflow and the business behind it, then help them make a confident decision. There’s volume here, and you’ll need to move quickly. We’ll help you view your pipeline systemically - what inputs and opportunities are needed, where you invest your time, what changes will make the greatest difference. Sales craft matters, as does knowing where to apply it. You’ll have the autonomy to test that judgement, with experienced people around you to sharpen it. We’re ambitious about the numbers and care deeply about what they represent: clinicians getting time back and patients getting more of their attention. People here push themselves, share what works and help each other get better. As AI changes what a salesperson can do, we expect you to question how we work and help build what comes next. What you’ll be doing Own deals from the first qualified conversation through to close, working with our deployment and customer success teams to get clinics using Heidi successfully. Turn inbound interest and product usage signals into paid adoption. Work out where one clinician’s enthusiasm could become a rollout across the business, and bring the right people into the conversation. Shape and execute our outbound motion to create a scalable % of sourced deals. Get close to how each clinic works. Run discovery and demos that connect Heidi to the problems clinicians, managers and owners actually want to solve. Own your revenue number and the pipeline needed to deliver it. Know your opportunity volume, conversion rates, deal sizes and sales cycle well enough to spot a shortfall early and act. Find where deals get stuck. Apply sales frameworks where they improve decisions and win rates, with enough judgement to keep straightforward deals moving quickly. Use AI and tools like HubSpot and Omni to reduce repetitive work, understand your accounts and improve how you sell. Test ideas, measure the result and share what works. Feed what you hear back into the business: why customers buy, why they hesitate, what competitors are doing and what would make adoption easier. What you’ll bring to the role You’ve shown you can turn a good conversation into a commercial outcome. That might be in sales, consulting, creative, growth, or another role where you’ve had to deeply understand a need, earn trust and secure a decision. You can think in systems and work with numbers. If your pipeline is underperforming, you can break the problem down, form a view on what needs to change and test it. You build rapport quickly and ask showstopping questions. You’re comfortable talking to a clinician about their working day and a business owner about whether an investment makes sense. You can keep a lot of deals moving without losing the detail. You run your own day, follow through on commitments and know where your attention will have the most impact. You’re curious about sales craft and thoughtful about how you use it. You want to understand why an approach works and when to adapt it. You use AI hands-on and have ideas about where it can improve your work. When something is slow or repetitive, you look for a way to fix it. You’re driven, open to coaching and willing to change your mind. You care about your own performance and put time into helping the people around you succeed. You care about what Heidi does. You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and keep their experience in view as you work towards your target. Bonus if you: Have closed deals in a high-volume SMB sales environment. Know UK private healthcare, particularly how independent practices and clinics buy and adopt new tools. Have worked in a product-led business and used product signals to identify and grow opportunities. Have built an AI workflow or automation that made you or your team more effective. How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford. Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander. Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless. Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi? You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally. We take care of you. We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office. Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all. description: We are growing! We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury for our Paris office. About CXG: Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide. The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation. We are passionate about delivering impact. Our clients include the world’s most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction. Overview We are currently looking to hire an experienced Automotive Business Development Director – Premium & Luxury, based in our Paris office. This is a strategic and highly commercial role for an entrepreneurial automotive expert who can leverage a strong senior network, create and convert new business opportunities, and help CXG expand its position with leading premium and luxury automotive brands. What you will be doing Reporting to CXG Chief Customer Officer, you will lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice. Your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to, the following: 1. Automotive Business Development Leadership Lead the commercial development of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, with direct ownership of new client acquisition and market expansion. Update and maintain a compelling Automotive value proposition that leverages CXG's capabilities, methodologies, resources, differentiators, and data, and addresses the priorities of stakeholders across the industry and regions, including brands, importers, distributors, and showroom management. Promote the value proposition internally and externally and constantly search for new ways to improve it. Serve as CXG's internal and external automotive industry expert and the key point of contact for automotive projects, strategic client discussions, and new business opportunities. Develop and execute a clear commercial strategy to acquire new automotive clients, personally leveraging an established senior network to generate qualified opportunities, build a strong pipeline, and convert prospects into sustainable revenue. Ensure all relevant parties are included in proposal preparation, so the most powerful offers are presented to prospects while taking current and future operational capacity into account. Establish the annual business plan, including revenue ambitions, priority accounts, pipeline targets, key commercial actions, and market development initiatives. Monitor the commercial performance of CXG's Automotive Industry practice, including pipeline development, conversion, and revenue growth, and provide clear reporting to management and the Executive Committee. 2. Client Development and Internal Expertise New client acquisition sits at the heart of this role. It is the primary criterion and the main measure of success. Create measurable value for both prospects and existing clients by connecting their business priorities with CXG's full range of capabilities. For existing clients, work closely with the CSMs responsible for automotive accounts and join meetings at key milestones, including the presentation of deliverables, discussions about account growth opportunities, and conversations on current client challenges. Use your expertise to strengthen the client dialogue, help resolve issues, and maximize additional business opportunities. Act as the internal subject matter expert for the CSMs managing automotive accounts, sharing relevant market, client, and industry knowledge to strengthen their credibility and effectiveness. Coach CSMs to identify whitespace, develop account expansion plans, and build stronger relationships with senior client stakeholders. Join client meetings whenever your expertise can increase the value of the discussion or support the conversion of an opportunity. Advise clients on CXG's Automotive value proposition, and ensure discussions cover our Measurement, Academy, Customer Insights, and Consulting capabilities. Own the business development effort for the Automotive Industry practice, from market mapping and opportunity creation through proposal development, negotiation, and conversion. Develop and nurture CXG's visibility and credibility across relevant automotive markets through active networking, industry events, thought leadership, and white papers. Requirements What you will bring along This role requires a genuine passion for the automotive and luxury industries. You should also have the below: Master's degree in Luxury Management, Business Administration, or a related field from a Business School or similar institution. Minimum 10 years of experience in the automotive sector, with significant exposure to consulting, marketing, sales, or business development in the premium or luxury segment. Fluent English is mandatory, with German as a plus and French as a nice-to-have. An extensive and active network of senior decision-makers across the premium and luxury automotive sector, with the credibility and relationship-building skills to open doors, create qualified opportunities, and position CXG's value proposition. This is a core requirement for the role. A strong and demonstrable business development track record, including originating opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and winning new clients or expanding strategic accounts. Demonstrable experience developing strategic and business plans. Deep knowledge of the premium and luxury automotive market, its commercial ecosystem, client priorities, and the trends and forces shaping the industry's development. Good understanding of corporate finance and measures of performance. Excellent organizational and leadership skills. Positive and outgoing personality. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, polished, persuasive, and diplomatic, with experience in presentations and proposal writing. Outstanding analytical and problem-solving abilities. A strong consulting approach and the ability to coach client-facing teams, translate industry expertise into commercial opportunities, and influence senior stakeholders. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ Your mission Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams. ⭐ Location On-site in Paris, Île-de-France. What makes this role genuinely unique You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond. You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market. You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale. You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership. ⭐ Your role Relationships & Presence Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level. Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy. Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given. Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage. Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts. Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios. Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides. Sector Engagement & Anticipation Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning. Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics. Build & Scale Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates. Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements). Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations. Market intelligence: Provide competitive intelligence on how brokers position Alan vs. incumbents, how they advise clients on insurer selection, and where we are perceived as "difficult to work with" — and feed that back into product, pricing, and GTM strategy. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE ROLE Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Tissus, le/la Chargé(e) de Sourcing et Développement Textile Senior assure le sourcing et le développement des matières textiles pour les collections de prêt-à-porter Homme et Femme JACQUEMUS. Grâce à son expertise textile, sa sensibilité produit et sa connaissance du marché, elle/il identifie les matières adaptées à la vision créative de la Maison et accompagne leur développement jusqu’à leur transmission aux équipes Achats. VOS MISSIONS 1. Sourcing textile Rechercher et sourcer les matières en accord avec les besoins des collections. Présenter régulièrement les sélections à la Responsable Tissus et aux équipes Design. Préparer et animer les rendez-vous fournisseurs. Participer aux salons textiles à Paris et à Milan. Assurer la gestion et l’organisation de la tissuthèque. 2. Développement textile Lancer et suivre les développements textiles : lab dips, impressions, jacquards et développements spécifiques. Assurer le suivi avec les fournisseurs et les techniciens des usines textiles. Garantir le respect des délais et des priorités de développement. Organiser la passation des développements à la Chargée des Achats Tissus. Assurer l’archivage et la traçabilité des développements. 3. Coordination et pilotage Élaborer et suivre le planning de sourcing et de développement avec les équipes. Vérifier les racks et les boards tissus avec la Chargée des Achats Tissus. Réaliser un point hebdomadaire avec les équipes Design et les Chefs de Produit. Contribuer à la mise en place du plan de collection matières et au suivi de son cadrage. Suivre le budget de développement textile. VOTRE PROFIL Minimum 4 ans d’expérience en sourcing et développement textile. Expertise des matières et bonne connaissance des fournisseurs et techniciens textiles. Forte sensibilité produit et intérêt marqué pour l’univers du textile. Curiosité, proactivité et sens des priorités. Maîtrise de l’anglais ; l’italien est un plus. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Your mission Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis). Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations). Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs). Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization. Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs. Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run. Your profile Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority. Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus! Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you. Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations. Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup. Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary. Why us? Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy. Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale. Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together. Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company. Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being. Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Erfahrung in der Führung von Teams und/oder größeren Projekten sowie in der Verantwortung für Budgets und Ressourcen. Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, digitale, AI- oder Data-Lösungen aufzubauen, einzuführen und zu skalieren. Verständnis für Claude, Python, Generative AI, LLMs, AI-Agenten und Automatisierung. Gute Kenntnisse in Data Governance, Datenplattformen, Analytics und Datenqualität. Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Systemen wie SAP BO oder ELO. Erfahrung mit Cloud- und AI-Plattformen, idealerweise im Microsoft-Umfeld Verständnis für den gesamten AI-Lifecycle – von der Idee über Piloten bis zum produktiven Betrieb. Erfahrung mit Business Cases, ROI-Betrachtungen und der wirtschaftlichen Bewertung von Technologie. Grundlegendes Verständnis moderner IT- und Microsoft-Umgebungen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst mit der Geschäftsführung über Strategie und Investitionen sprechen, mit operativen Führungskräften über Prozesse und mit technischen Spezialisten über Architektur, Daten und AI. Erfahrung in Change-Management und im Aufbau von AI-/Data-Kompetenzen in Fachbereichen, die neu mit diesen Themen in Berührung kommen. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you. At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started. Role Overview Harvey's law school program has reached 50+ US schools in year one. Now we are taking it global, and we need the right person to lead that charge expanding in the EMEA, and APAC markets. As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work. You will start by taking over account management of existing EMEA partner schools and then look to sign and expand our presence across the region. Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for every school in your portfolio — owning relationships with faculty, library staff, student organizations, and administrators across each partner institution. Training & Enablement: Run all product training, demos, workspace setup, and activation events for your portfolio — including semester-start all-hands pushes, large-group faculty workshops, and 1:1 curriculum advisory sessions. Draw on the global Content Specialist and CS Lead for materials and operational support. Ambassador Programs: Launch and own the EMEA student ambassador and faculty champion networks, adapting the US/UK model for European legal education norms. Curriculum Advisory: Advise faculty and curriculum committees on how to integrate Harvey into courses, clinics, and legal writing programs — doing the hands-on work that makes academic embeds real. L'équipe Core Data Product de DECATHLON recherche ses futur-e-s Data Engineers en stage basé·e·s à Lille. 

Au cœur de l’entité Decathlon Digital, nous recherchons nos futur.es Data Engineers pour rejoindre les équipes Core Data Products.

Rejoignez l'équipe Core Data Products : Au cœur des décisions stratégiques de Decathlon

Au sein de notre Data Platform, vous évoluerez sur le socle qui alimente l'ensemble des décisions stratégiques et des modèles d'IA de Decathlon.

Notre mission ? Construire la Single Source of Truth transversale pour transformer les données brutes en produits de données prêts à l'emploi (Gold layer), fiables et normés. 

Du design produit à la supply chain, en passant par l'éco-conception et l'expérience client, nos Core Data Products permettent à chaque équipe métier d'opérer avec agilité tout en propulsant des business models circulaires, rentables et responsables.

Ton futur terrain de jeu 

Les Core Data Products sont organisés en équipes expertes, chacune pilotée par un binôme Tech Lead & Product Manager.
Tu intégreras l' Équipe INDUSTRY SUPPLY INVENTORY dont la mission est d'unifier les données de la chaîne d'approvisionnement grâce à des produits de données prêts à évoluer à grande échelle. 

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

Architecture & Stratégie Technique

  • Contribuer à l'élaboration de la stratégie de nos stacks techniques et garantir la CI/CD.
  • Maintenir et repenser les datasets et pipelines existants pour servir une plus large variété de use cases.
  • Concevoir, développer et industrialiser des modèles de données complexes pour permettre l'analyse des usages, de la qualité et de la maturité de notre patrimoine de données.

Expertise & Accompagnement

  • Compréhension des besoins fonctionnels : Proactivité dans l’analyse du besoin et la compréhension du quotidien des utilisateurs qu’on accompagne et de leurs stakeholders.
  • Support et accompagnement : Agir en tant qu'expert pour guider les équipes data dans l'utilisation correcte et efficace de nos produits.
  • Contribuer activement à notre communauté de data engineers.

Culture Engineering & Excellence

  • Promotion des bonnes pratiques : Contribuer activement à l'amélioration continue de nos méthodes de travail (mob programming, TDD, documentation robuste...) pour élever les standards techniques de l'équipe.
  • Excellence opérationnelle : Mettre en œuvre des solutions de monitoring et d'automatisation pour réduire considérablement la charge de travail manuelle et améliorer l'efficacité globale de l'équipe.

 

TON ENVIRONNEMENT TECHNIQUE

  • Amazon Web Services S3, Glue, EMR
  • Databricks, Unity Catalog
  • Apache Spark (PySpark)
  • Ordonnancement avec Airflow (Python)
  • Kafka
  • Open Source framework : Great expectations, Open Lineage
  • Github

CE DONT TU AS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR

  • Une première expérience significative (projets universitaire, stage ou alternance) dans un environnement technique similaire.
  • Une appétence forte pour le travail en équipe et une culture du partage.
  • Un intérêt pour l’impact du sport sur le développement personnel et collectif.
  • L’envie de rejoindre une entreprise engagée dans le Tech4Good et l’innovation responsable.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.

BERICHTET AN:                    IT-Manager Europa

 

 

AXS ist ein führender Anbieter fortschrittlicher Ticketing- und Live-Event-Technologie und in Nordamerika, Europa und im asiatisch-pazifischen Raum aktiv. Das Unternehmen ermöglicht den Zugang zu einigen der weltweit bekanntesten Veranstaltungsorte, Sportteams, Festivals und Welttourneen. Mit maßgeschneiderten Ticketing-Lösungen, innovativer Technologie und engagiertem Kundenservice arbeitet AXS mit über 1.600 der renommiertesten Marken aus Sport und Unterhaltung zusammen – darunter die Olympischen und Paralympischen Spiele 28 in Los Angeles, die Eisbären in Berlin, das Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival, das Red Rocks Amphitheatre, First Avenue, die O2 Arena, die BNP Paribas Open, die WM Phoenix Open und das Stagecoach Country Music Festival, sowie die Barclays Arena in Hamburg und die Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin. Die primären und sekundären Marktplätze von AXS sowie die firmeneigene AXS Mobile ID-Technologie bieten Fans die einfachste und sicherste Möglichkeit, Tickets zu kaufen, zu verkaufen und zu verwalten.
 

 

DIE ROLLE

Der IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) ist ein wichtiger Teil unseres technischen Teams. Du beaufsichtigst und verwaltest interne und kundenseitige Systeme und Hardware und stellst den reibungslosen Systembetrieb sicher. Alles was du tust, erfolgt im Einklang mit der europäischen IT-Strategie, in der du ebenfalls eingebunden bist. Du leistet technischen Support für die Mitarbeitenden und unterstützt Teammitglieder. Du stellst sicher, dass alle  alle IT-bezogenen Aufgaben korrekt und fristgerecht erledigt werden  und hilfst dem IT-Manager Europa bei der Lösung von Herausforderungen.

 

ÜBER SIE

Du hast ein echtes Interesse und eine Leidenschaft für IT-Systeme. Du bist gut organisiert und hast eine pragmatische Herangehensweise mit einem akribischen Blick für Details. Du arbeitest gerne in einem hohen Arbeitstempo, bist flexibel und hast Freude am Umgang mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Du bist Experte für unsere wichtigsten Systeme und in der Lage Probleme zu erkennen, diese schnell, professionell und mit minimalen Auswirkungen auf das operative Geschäft zu beheben. Geduld zeichnet dich aus.   

 

HAUPTVERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

 

  • Werde Teil des europäischen IT-Support-Teams, arbeite eng mit Kolleg*innen in anderen EU-Märkten zusammen und unterstütze sie bei Bedarf.
  • Als technischer Ansprechpartnerin für unser Client Services Team unterstützt Du bei allen Fragen rund um Ticketing-Equipment in unseren Venues.
  • Du verwaltest unser zentrales Geräte- und MDM-System und passt Geräteprofile flexibel an.
  • Du behältst jederzeit den Überblick über unsere Hardware und führst genaue Asset-Listen.
  • Du stellst sicher, dass unsere IT-Systeme den AXS-Sicherheitsstandards entsprechen.
  • Du bearbeitest Service-Desk-Tickets aus Deutschland – schnell, professionell und lösungsorientiert.
  • Du installierst, wartest und reparierst AXS-Equipment an verschiedenen Veranstaltungsstandorten in Deutschland.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Senior IT Manager Europe zusammen und unterstützt Dein Team bei allen IT-Herausforderungen.

 

 

SCHLÜSSELQUALIFIKATIONEN UND ERFAHRUNGEN

 

  • Du hast Erfahrung im 2nd-Level-Support und brennst für IT-Themen.
  • Du kennst Dich sehr gut mit Windows-Clients aus und hast idealerweise erste Berührungspunkte mit MacOS.

description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Vinted’s Revenue domain is growing — Ads business is on the mission to develop an advertising ecosystem within Vinted and we’re just getting started. We’re looking for a Lead Data Scientist to join our cross-functional team in Ads to help us make the most of our real estate and evolve toward a high‑performance, privacy‑respectful, in‑house advertising ecosystem over time. Think: an ad of an external partner can generate euros directly but we may well advertise our own Marketplace services or newly launched categories to optimise on net revenue as well as user engagement. 

If you have built performance-first Ad optimisation systems and are ready to take on hands-on work while shaping the Data Science roadmaps from a greenfield state - this role is for you.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Own optimization logic for Ads systems. Own the data science approach behind core Ads optimization problems such as ranking, targeting, pacing, budget allocation, candidate selection, and auction or bidding logic where relevant.
  • Develop practical approaches that improve advertiser performance, marketplace relevance, and business outcomes.
  • Take charge of model and algorithm development. Design, develop, and iterate models and algorithmic approaches used in Ads delivery and optimization. This may include prediction, scoring, calibration, exploration/exploitation methods, and constrained optimization approaches suited to Vinted’s marketplace context.
  • Lead experimentation and performance improvement frameworks. Own the analytical and experimental process for improving optimization systems. Define hypotheses, evaluation frameworks or logic changes and support translating learnings into better system behavior.
  • Guide objective function and constraint design. Help define optimization objectives that balance advertiser value, revenue, user experience, and operational constraints. Turn product and business goals into tractable optimization problems and implementable Data Science logic.
  • Be responsible for Ads performance diagnostics. Own deep-dive analysis of system behavior and performance degradation. Identify where delivery, relevance, auction dynamics, supply-demand imbalance, or model issues are limiting outcomes, and propose solutions.
  • Contribute to Production implementation in Ads. Partner with engineering and Decision Scientists to move models and optimization logic from idea to reliable implementation.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Decision Scientists, Analytics Engineers and developers to shape advertiser-facing features and internal optimization capabilities with a clear understanding of feasibility, impact, and tradeoffs from the Data Science perspective.
  • Collaborate with Decision Science counterparts and other Data Scientists to ensure optimization changes are evaluated with appropriate metrics, guardrails, and marketplace context.
  • Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, and backend teams to ensure training data, feedback loops, online signals, and offline datasets are suitable for robust optimization work.
  • Help explain system behavior, performance drivers, and expected impacts of optimization changes to non-technical stakeholders when needed.

About you 

We are looking for someone who combines:

  • strong applied machine learning and statistical skills,
  • experience with Ad Tech systems and optimization problems,
  • strong product and business judgment,
  • comfort working on production systems with engineers,
  • and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, evolving domains.

The strongest candidates will have experience in areas such as:

  • ads ranking,
  • auction systems,
  • pacing and budget optimization,
  • marketplace or recommendation systems,
  • relevance modeling,
  • or other real-time optimization environments where multiple objectives must be balanced.
  • Well-versed in Python and SQL, BigQuery is an advantage
  • Have a structured, meticulous way of working when trying out different approaches towards a set goal
  • Be a conscious team player who understands when their work touches that of other team members and proactively aligns with them
  • Good at explaining details of machine learning methods to lay audiences
  • Solid written and spoken English

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities often apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. If you don’t recognise yourself in all of the above, you might still be an excellent candidate for this position. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 30 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per your workday
  • Frequent team-building events
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Access to a discounted gym membership plan
  • Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution
  • Supplemental Private Health Insurance
  • Life and Disability insurance
  • A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual Learning Budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid Work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ? L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés. Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité. Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent. L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes. Ce poste est clé pour : construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ; accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ; transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ; sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ; faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés. Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité. Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux. Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole. En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact. Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 % Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation. Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement. Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification. Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée. Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 % Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres. Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants. Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux. Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole. Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain. Familiarity with the clinical journals, publishers, guideline bodies, societies and universities that hold medical knowledge. A background in health tech, clinical informatics, research, quality improvement, product operations or an early-stage company. How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly.   • Own the operational playbook for data reliability: data contracts, quality checks, lineage, monitoring, and incident response.

  • Ensure data products also power ML workflows: trusted training datasets, feature-ready outputs, and consistent definitions for decision-making.
  • Enable AI automation by delivering reliable, low-latency, governed data products that can be used safely in automated workflows.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and security stakeholders to align data products to roadmap priorities and customer outcomes.
  • Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, standards, and mentoring—while staying hands-on in key systems.

Required

  • Significant experience building and operating production data platforms at scale, including on-call and operational ownership.
  • Strong SQL skills and strong Python skills, used to build pipelines, services, and automation.
  • Hands-on experience running cloud systems on AWS and Google Cloud (IaaS level: compute, storage, networking, IAM).
  • Practical experience with both operational databases (RDS-style) and analytics stores (columnar/OLAP), including performance tuning.
  • Strong data modeling ability, including schema evolution, conformed dimensions, and “one source of truth” metric definitions.
  • Track record of delivering data products that other teams or customers depend on, with clear contracts and reliability expectations.
  • Ability to make sound engineering tradeoffs across latency, accuracy, cost, and security without creating brittle complexity.
  • Experience with lakehouse patterns and open table formats (or similar), including governance and table maintenance.
  • Experience with orchestration and streaming systems used in production (batch + real-time), and managing backfills safely.
  • Familiarity with ML data needs (training/serving splits, feature-ready datasets, evaluation datasets) and AI-adjacent workflows.

Preferred

  • Experience building self-service data platforms (catalog, discoverability, access controls) used by multiple teams.
  • Experience in regulated or security-sensitive environments, including retention, auditing, and data access controls.

CoreWeave is seeking an exceptional Regional Director, Revenue Operations — EMEA to serve as the operational leader of our revenue engine across the EMEA region. Reporting directly to the Global Vice President, Revenue Operations and serving as the strategic operational partner to the VP & Managing Director, EMEA, you will both help shape CoreWeave’s global revenue operations operating model and drive its performance in EMEA — working shoulder-to-shoulder with the global Centers of Excellence to build the standards, systems, and frameworks, then bringing them to life in-region to deliver predictable, efficient, and accelerated growth. Your mandate is to make the operating model deliver market-commanding performance in EMEA while ensuring the region’s realities shape what “global” means.

This is a pivotal moment for CoreWeave, as we scale our revenue operations infrastructure to support our trajectory as a newly public AI hyperscaler. You will bring enterprise-grade operational rigor to the region while maintaining the startup mindset, agility, and innovation that defines CoreWeave. As a senior voice within global RevOps and a leader on the EMEA field team, you will operate as a peer to the Centers of Excellence — co-designing the global operating model, championing its adoption across the EMEA field, and ensuring the region has the insights and execution to achieve its ambitious revenue targets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Business Partnering: Serve as the strategic operational partner to the VP & Managing Director, EMEA and regional go-to-market leadership, providing data-driven insights, scenario modeling, and operational recommendations that inform strategic decisions across the region.
  • Regional Forecasting & Pipeline Management: Apply the global forecasting methodologies and revenue analytics frameworks to give regional leadership accurate, real-time visibility into EMEA pipeline health, revenue performance, and growth trajectories across segments, products, and geographies.
  • Regional Operating Rhythms: Build and run the region’s operating cadence — QBRs, business reviews, and performance reviews presided over by the VP & Managing Director, EMEA — anchored to a common global operating-rhythm framework and extended with the regional reviews and nuances EMEA requires, orchestrating the agenda, insights, and follow-through that instill discipline, drive accountability, and deliver over-achievement of results across the EMEA field.
  • Global COE Partnership: Partner as a peer with the global RevOps Centers of Excellence (Planning, Process & Automation, Readiness, Deal Strategy) to co-design the global operating model, bringing EMEA’s perspective to shape the standards, systems, and frameworks the region will run on.
  • Global Deal Framework Influence: Feed EMEA customer feedback, market trends, currency, and legal nuance into the global deal framework — pricing, commercial, and contract standards owned by Deal Strategy & Execution — to shape worldwide pricing and commercial strategy.
  • Global Field Initiatives Rollout & Adoption: Lead the EMEA rollout and adoption of global initiatives across every RevOps Center of Excellence — including Field Planning & Performance (quota, compensation, and territory rollouts), Field Readiness (training, enablement, and certification programs), and Field Process & Automation (process, systems, and AI) — driving change management and adoption that streamline regional operations so the sales organization can focus on selling, ensuring consistency with worldwide standards while respecting local market nuance.
  • Region-Specific Initiatives & Programs: Design and drive region-specific initiatives and programs that address the unique dynamics of the EMEA market.

Who You Are

  • 15+ years in field/revenue/sales operations, with experience as a regional business partner to senior field leadership.
  • Proven success operating across EMEA markets, managing complexity across multiple geographies, currencies, and time zones.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and operating-rhythm discipline in high-growth B2B technology.
  • CRM fluency and comfort with revenue intelligence and analytics tooling; able to turn data into regional insight.
  • Track record driving adoption of global programs at the regional level through strong change management.
  • Commercial and deal fluency — experience partnering with Finance on forecasting and with sales leadership on commercial proposals, approvals, and negotiation strategy — with the credibility to influence global pricing and commercial standards from a regional seat.
  • Cloud infrastructure or AI/ML market experience preferred; multilingual and cross-cultural fluency a plus.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. description: Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides. Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission. description:
ABOUT PROPRIETARY RESEARCH

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence— you will uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep compliant fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. In partnership with our investment professionals and Compliance team, our team of analysts, data scientists and engineers work together to produce compliant research and build tools that inform our firm’s investments. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Sector Analyst for European Equities, you will work with alternative data to gather industry context and business fundamentals. You will then partner with our team of data scientists and engineers to develop analyses that you’ll deliver as synthesized insights to our investment professionals to help aid in their research processes. The work is ever evolving, affording opportunities to tackle new challenges alongside research teammates from diverse backgrounds. Specifically, you will:

  • Analyze and interpret alternative data from multiple sources and develop subject-matter expertise on the key themes and KPIs that drive the industry and companies within your assigned coverage
  • Produce research for internal consumption by our investment professionals across a variety of mediums, including written research reports, verbal communication, and visualization tools
  • Interact directly with our investment professionals to learn the discretionary investment process and help them to drive more informed investment decisions
  • Collaborate with our proprietary research teams including Data Sourcing, Data Science, and Data Engineering, as well as Compliance, to source, evaluate, and draw value from new and existing data assets to produce actionable research for investment professionals

WHAT’S REQUIRED  

  • An undergraduate or advanced degree with demonstrated academic success
  • One to five years of prior equity/investment/scientific/industry research or consulting experience, including any relevant internship experience
  • Proficiency with technical coding/programming and ability to participate in a live technical screen (SQL, Python)
  • Experience leveraging data analysis as part of the fundamental research process for business, public policy, finance, engineering, applied sciences, or other quantitative fields
  • Comfort with analyzing novel data and explaining concepts to non-technical partners
  • A passion for finance, research, and using data to solve problems
  • Great organizational skills to handle a demanding workload, creativity, and a strong work ethic
  • Ability to operate productively in a team environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Commitment to the highest ethical standards

WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

  • Private Medical and Dental Insurances
  • Generous parental and family leave policies
  • Volunteer opportunities
  • Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of colour and the LGBQT+ community
  • Mental and physical wellness programmes
  • Tuition assistance
  • Non-contributory pension and more

ABOUT POINT72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit www.Point72.com/about.

description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

StackAdapt is a self-serve advertising platform that specializes in multi-channel solutions including native, display, video, connected TV, audio, in-game, and digital out-of-home ads. We empower hundreds of digitally-focused companies to deliver outcomes and exceptional campaign performance everyday. StackAdapt was founded with a vision to be more than an advertising platform, it’s a hub of innovation, imagination and creativity.

Reporting to the Manager of Enterprise Client Services, you’ll play an integral role in client relationships and driving adoption of the StackAdapt platform, campaign management, and account expansion opportunities across Enterprise brands and agencies. You’ll work closely with your Account Executives and Ad Operations Specialists to maximize campaign ROI of our customers.

StackAdapt is a Remote First company, however we are prioritizing candidates based in the UK for this role. 

What you'll be doing:

  • Act as the main point of contact for your portfolio of clients across a wide range of verticals and clients
  • Work alongside your Account Executives in leading the RFP process, proposals, multi-channel media plans, and presentation to Enterprise brands and agencies
  • Drive up-sells of StackAdapt features and channels to existing customers, while identifying new expansion opportunities and developing tools, procedures, and reports to increase service efficiency
  • Design unique campaign strategies within the StackAdapt platform
  • Ensure client campaigns are successful by providing regular reporting on their campaign goals, providing strategic solutions and optimizations to meet identified KPIs
  • Deep client mapping and account planning expertise
  • Set up/traffic advertising campaigns on the StackAdapt DSP, including third party tag implementation and pixel creation/troubleshooting
  • Optimize campaigns and recommend new opportunities by analyzing campaign performance on a regular basis
  • In-person and virtual meetings, presentations, Quarterly Business Reviews and training/education

What you'll bring to the table:

  • Extensive Real Time Bidding/programmatic expertise (DSP, Ad Network)
  • Proven success in managing client relationships and skilled up-selling to unlock new revenue streams across your book of business
  • Experience working with multi-million ($10M+) dollar budgets
  • Experience in the RFP process; putting together proposals and multi-channel media plans, working cross-functionally internally, and presenting concepts to clients in a fast-paced environment with quick turn-arounds
  • Strong experience with measurement, attribution, incrementality, and conversion journey story-telling
  • Preferred experience managing Large, Enterprise B2B accounts, with a proven track record of servicing both brand direct and agency clients
  • The ability to grasp and communicate technical concepts and platform-based knowledge
  • Flexibility to travel to meet with clients within their region
 

The compensation range listed for this role reflects the expected base salary for candidates located in the posting country based on a global rate. It is informed by market data and the approved budget for this position. StackAdapt maintains different compensation ranges for roles across other countries and regions, and final offers will be aligned to the candidate’s current location. This range represents base salary only. Depending on the role, candidates may also be eligible for additional compensation such as annual bonuses, commissions, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits package.

description: Zur Verstärkung unserer Crew suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen (Senior) Controller – Produktion & Supply Chain Management (m/w/d). Wer wir sind? Na, wer kennt uns nicht? Im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes sind wir in aller Munde. Unser Gewürz Ketchup - ja, der mit dem grünen Deckel - ist eine echte Legende. Aber wusstest du, dass wir noch viel mehr zu bieten haben? Mit über 600 Crew-Mitgliedern an zehn Standorten weltweit sind wir in der Gewürzwelt zuhause. Bei uns heißt es: Immer einen Schritt voraus sein, Herausforderungen spielend meistern & Genuss neu erleben. Genau diese Grundsätze machen uns zu einem zuverlässigen Lieferanten von hochwertigen Produkten in der Lebensmittelherstellung. Deine Rolle: Die Brücke zwischen Shopfloor und Zahlenwelt Um es gleich vorwegzunehmen: Wir suchen nicht die berühmte „eierlegende Wollmilchsau“. Niemand bringt von Tag eins an alles perfekt mit. Uns ist viel wichtiger, dass Du in einem unserer Kernbereiche – sei es Supply Chain Management, Lean Management oder operatives Controlling – bereits tiefgehende Erfahrungen gesammelt hast und für die angrenzenden Themen das nötige prozessuale und kaufmännische Verständnis mitbringst. In dieser Rolle agierst Du als Business Partner für unsere Fachbereiche. Du verbindest operatives Know-how mit Weitblick und hilfst uns dabei, unsere gesamte Wertschöpfungskette – vom Einkauf über die Produktion bis zur Logistik – im anspruchsvollen Lebensmittelumfeld effizient zu steuern. Was Dir an spezifischem Fachwissen im ein oder anderen Bereich noch fehlt, erarbeiten wir uns gemeinsam! Klingt spannend? Dann nichts wie los! Werde Teil unserer Hela Crew & erlebe selbst, wie es ist, in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das wirklich schmeckt. Bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns auf Dich! Hier gestaltest Du aktiv mit: Prozesse verstehen & strukturieren: Du nimmst unsere Prozesse entlang der Wertschöpfung (Einkauf, Produktion und Logistik) auf, dokumentierst sie und behältst Schnittstellen sowie Mengengerüste im Blick. Zahlen-zu-Prozess-Denken: Du begleitest unsere Lean- und Continuous-Improvement-Initiativen. Dabei hilfst Du, Optimierungspotenziale im Werk aufzudecken und sie in belastbaren Zahlen greifbar zu machen. Performance Measurement & SCM: Du identifizierst sinnvolle Messpunkte (z. B. Rüstvorgänge, Wareneingänge) und baust gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen aussagekräftige Kennzahlen (wie OEE oder Materialverbrauch) auf. Gleichzeitig hast Du Lagerbestände und Logistikkosten im Blick. Datenbeschaffung & Kalkulation: Du führst Kosten- und Mengendaten aus unseren Systemen (ERP/BI) zusammen, plausibilisierst diese und wirkst daran mit, prozessorientierte Kostensätze und transparente Rechenlogiken abzuleiten. Analysen & Handlungsempfehlungen: Identifikation von Kostentreibern und Effizienzpotenzialen im Werk sowie Ableitung konkreter Handlungsempfehlungen für die Produktion, Logistik und Einkauf sowie angrenzende Bereiche Deine Basis: Du hast bereits fundierte Berufserfahrung in mindestens einem dieser Bereiche gesammelt: Supply Chain Management, Lean Management/Produktion oder operatives Produktionscontrolling. Das richtige Mindset: Du musst kein reiner Finanz-Experte und Lean-Profi in einer Person sein. Wichtig ist, dass Du das Zusammenspiel der Prozesse (Einkauf, Produktion, SCM) verstehst und die Sprache der Operations genauso sprichst wie die der Zahlen. System-Know-how: Du gehst souverän mit Excel um und bringst eine generelle IT-Affinität für ERP-Systeme (z. B. SAP oder vergleichbar) sowie idealerweise für moderne BI-Tools (z. B. Power BI) mit. Persönlichkeit: Eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigeninitiative und eine positive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise. Du bist belastbar, zuverlässig und kommunizierst sicher mit internen und externen Ansprechpartnern. Branchenwissen (Nice-to-have): Erfahrung im Lebensmittel- oder FMCG-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Auch kluge Köpfe aus anderen produzierenden Branchen (z. B. Automotive, Maschinenbau, Chemie) passen hervorragend zu uns, wenn sie Freude daran haben, sich in unsere Prozesse einzuarbeiten. Deine Vorteile Ein attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket Ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld in einem Unternehmen mit mehr als 120 Jahren Tradition Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege Mobiles Arbeiten 36,75 Std.
